title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in WPTasty AWP…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in WPTasty AWP Classifieds (another-wordpress-classifieds-plugin) versions up to 4.4.10. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute in users' browsers.
